data.title: Landlord's termination of the lease (Kündigung des Mietverhältnisses)
data.summary: The law firm Kanzlei Exempelrain & Kollegen, acting on behalf of the landlords Eheleute Mustertaler, formally terminates the lease for the ground-floor apartment at Innstraße 21, effective 31 May 2027, citing the landlord's need for a ground-floor apartment after an accident.
data.explanation: Your landlords' lawyer has ended your tenancy, effective 31 May 2027, because one of the landlords needs this ground-floor apartment after an accident. German law (§§ 574–574b BGB) lets you object if moving out would be a hardship for you or your family that outweighs the landlord's interest, and ask to continue the tenancy. The app will show the deadline by which any such written objection must reach the lawyer. If you do nothing, you are expected to vacate by the end date. Consider getting advice from a tenants' association (Mieterverein) or lawyer before the deadline shown, since hardship objections can be complex.

items.title: Decide whether to object to the termination (Widerspruch nach §§ 574–574b BGB)
items.action: Decide whether moving out would be a hardship for you or your family and, if so, send a written objection (in Textform) to the landlords' lawyer
items.consequence: If no timely objection is sent, you lose the right to demand continuation of the tenancy and must vacate by the end date
items.quote: Der Widerspruch bedarf der Textform und muss mir spätestens zwei Monate vor dem Ende des Mietverhältnisses zugehen.

items.action: Plan to vacate the apartment by this date unless you successfully object to the termination
items.consequence: If you do not move out and have not successfully objected, the landlord may pursue eviction through the courts
